name: calc_compound_interest
description:
Future value of a lump sum with periodic compounding: FV = P(1 + r/n)^(n*t). Computed locally in Python; no API key or network.
Returns {principal, rate, years, future_value, total_interest}, amounts rounded to 2 decimals.
Inputs (* required): principal* (amount), rate* (annual rate in percent, 5 = 5%), years* (may be fractional), compounds_per_year (integer; default 12, monthly).
For annual compounding use calc_future_value; with yearly contributions calc_retirement; to discount back calc_present_value.
Example: {"principal": 10000, "rate": 5, "years": 10, "compounds_per_year": 12}
